footnotes: 1 GM, geometric mean of the MIC values. When no detectable antimicrobial activity was observed at 128 μM, a value of 256 μM was used for calculation of the GM value. 2 HC10 is the minimal inhibitory concentration that induced 10% hemolysis of human red blood cells. 3 Therapeutic index (TI) is calculated as HC10/GM. Larger values indicate greater cell selectivity.
